peer-width-process-final-0000-02.script:
proc main
fopen 4 "D:\WIDE.LOG" "wb"
fputs 4 "START|"
pause 2
transmit "SCRIPTREADY^M"
waitfor "WIDTHREADY" 8
if failure
fputs 4 "FAILWIDTH|"
fclose 4
exit
endif
fputs 4 "WIDE|"
pause 1
run "D:\CHILD.COM"

waitfor "RESUMED" 8

else

endif
fclose 4
endproc
